title: Deep learning prediction of patient response time course from early data via neural-pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic modelling.
summary: A neural PK/PD model predicted patient platelet-count time courses from early clinical data and was compared with population PK/PD using a held-out patient split.
ai_technology: The neural PK/PD model encoded dose-driven PK and PK/PD-dependent response dynamics in an ODE-based network.

evidence.tested: A neural PK/PD model predicted patient platelet-count time courses from early clinical data and was compared with population PK/PD using a held-out patient split.
evidence.unknown: A held-out patient split compared predicted platelet-count courses with population PK/PD; clinical efficacy was not tested.
evidence.ai_role: The neural PK/PD model encoded dose-driven PK and PK/PD-dependent response dynamics in an ODE-based network.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
